Dear Bill,

Thank you very much for sharing such valuable information regarding the prospective newbuilding projects by GIGA / Polaris Shipping.

As we remember, the 2 x 1,800 TEU container ships (Hull No. 30493W & 30494X) ordered at Huanghai Shipyard with BV class in 2021 were indeed ordered under Polaris Shipping's name, but they were actually ordered by Hanwon Maritime, which is Chairman Han Hee-seung's personal company of Polaris Shipping Group.( For your reference, Polaris Shipping is considered to have two owners as major shareholders: Chairman Han Hee-seung and Chairman Kim Wan-joong.)

I have a scheduled meeting with Polaris Shipping's newbuilding team head this week, and I will also visit Hanwon Maritime simultaneously to request them to select BV class for their upcoming projects. Additionally, I will approach Chairman Han Hee-seung to kindly request his consideration for selecting BV class once again for these new projects.

I will keep you continuously updated on all related developments and progress.

Thank you again for your support and coordination.

Dear Sangjin,

GIGA / Polaris Shipping is closely discussing with Huanghai S/Y with intention for ordering 2 +(2) x 2,700 TEU; in parallel, GIGA / Polaris Shipping is also discussing with Huangpu-Wenchong S/Y with intention for ordering 2 (+2) x 1,900 TEU.

The 2,700 TEU project is a SDARI design, BV had 2 ships being built at another yard, and Huanghai S/Y do not have reference yet.

The 1,900 TEU is a Huangpu-Wenchong S/Y’s in-house design, NK prototype approval, later DNV, CCS and LR won numbers of ship in series by signing MOU.

Please do best to pursue above 2 NC Opps and keep us duly informed.

The last newbuilding 2 x 1,800 TEU container ships ordered by GIGA / Polaris Shipping at Huanghai S/Y were classed by BV (delivered in Y2023);

Below trailed mails are just for your kind references to have an overall picture of feeder projects being under discussion at Huanghai S/Y…
